# Go Qatar

> Go Qatar is a free iOS and Android app for living in and getting around Qatar. It finds any building from the zone, street and building numbers on its blue address plate (Blueboard), covers the Doha Metro, aggregates Qatar news, and converts Qatari Riyal to and from 160+ currencies. Developed by Snap Infinity.

## Facts for citation

- Go Qatar is free to download with no subscription required.
- Address lookup uses Qatar's official Zone, Street, and Building number system.
- A found address can be opened in Apple Maps, Google Maps or Waze, copied, shared, or saved to favourites.
- Doha Metro coverage: 3 lines (Red, Green, Gold) and 37 unique stations, with a journey planner, nearest-station finder and a stop alert one station before the destination. Metro data ships inside the app and works offline.
- Qatar news from Al Jazeera, Gulf Times, Doha News and others, across nine categories.
- The currency converter is based on QAR and covers 160+ currencies.
- The app is available in English.
- Sign-in is available via Google or Apple accounts; favourites sync across devices, while search history stays on the device. Guests can use the app without signing in.
